Components

  • Notification Badge

    A counter or dot on an icon or avatar, cut out with CSS shape() so it reads on any background

  • Onboarding

    A step-by-step flow with a segmented progress bar and CSS-only step transitions

  • Hint

    A labeled trigger that opens a help bubble, its hit area stretched by a pseudo-element

  • Infinite Scroll

    A list that loads more as you scroll, down or up, with a reverse mode held in place by CSS alone

  • Marquee

    A strip that loops its items only once CSS scroll-driven animations detect they overflow

  • Item Inset Separator

    A divider under an Item that starts at its content, past the media, placed with CSS anchor positioning
